assumptions.statement: Site boundary and three key areas are provisional_constraint polygons from brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson. They are unsuitable for official redline, approval, or precise statutory area claims.
assumptions.impact: All area metrics must be recalculated when official polygons arrive; content scoring remains eligible with disclosure.

assumptions.statement: Approved FAR, height, density, setback, road redlines, municipal utilities, and fire-access controls are missing from the public site package.
assumptions.impact: Intensity and engineering conclusions remain unknown or conceptual suggestions only.

assumptions.statement: Parcel ownership, as-built building footprints, storeys, and retain/renovate/demolish decisions are not available as cleared survey data.
assumptions.impact: Building actions in this package are conceptual envelopes for discussion with professional teams.

assumptions.statement: Heritage protection boundaries, park implementation edges, and municipal network drawings are not in the cleared package.
assumptions.impact: Constraint layer is advisory annotation only and must not be read as statutory control.

assumptions.statement: All spatial moves, events, branding, investment/attraction pathways, and operations mechanisms are conceptual suggestions or reference schemes for professional deepening.
assumptions.impact: No text may be interpreted as government approval, funded commitment, or final regulatory plan.
